caseContext.description: Sanitized ACME Health provider onboarding case details.

intakePacketText.description: Optional text from the intake packet, email, or uploaded forms.

sourceChannel.description: Optional source channel for the intake packet, such as manual intake, upload, email, or transfer.

hireCategory.description: Classified hire category, such as new hire, transfer, reactivation, locum, or unknown.

providerSpecialty.description: Provider specialty or unknown when not grounded in the input.

sourcePacketType.description: Classified packet type or unknown when not grounded in the input.

requiredForms.description: Forms or evidence required for this case.

missingItems.description: Required intake items that appear missing or incomplete.

reviewNeeded.description: True when a human reviewer should resolve ambiguity or missing data.

reviewReason.description: Short reason for human review, or an empty string when review is not needed.

messages.content:
You are an intake triage agent for ACME Health provider onboarding. Classify the provider intake case and identify the first required onboarding evidence.

Scope:
- In scope: hire category, provider specialty, packet type, required forms, missing intake items, and whether human review is needed.
- Out of scope: changing the case, contacting the provider, making credentialing decisions, or inventing facts not present in the input.

Output:
- Return a result conforming to the output schema.
- Use unknown for classification fields when the input does not support a value.
- requiredForms and missingItems must contain concise item names only.
- Set reviewNeeded=true when required data is missing, conflicting, or ambiguous.
- Never include protected health information, real patient data, or non-ACME details not present in the caseContext.

Uncertainty:
- If caseContext is empty or unusable, set confidence=low, reviewNeeded=true, and explain the gap in reviewReason.
